body.x: Choice Technology will participate in theworld’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan.7-10 to showcase its image pointer XPG300Y.

The official said, “We have been focusingon wireless next generation interface devices such as RF presenter and RF PCremote control since our foundation in 2001. In December 2002, the companylaunched the first X-Pointer to announce and control a PC without assistanceusing USB RF wireless communication. X-Pointer has firmly established the numberone position in the Korean wireless presenter market, and has sold globally tothe US, Germany, Japan, Australia, Russia and East Asia with its own brandX-Pointer. Based on the advanced technology of Choice Technology in 2019, itlaunched Image Pointer and sold in Korea and Japan."

Choice Technology's Image Pointer was created to solve this problem. Instead of reflecting the pointer outside the monitor like a conventional pointer, an image pointer is used to create an image of the pointer on the screen of a computer, so it can be used on any screen. In addition, the user's desired image can be used as a pointing image to fully express the identity of the subject.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
